subject: financial_literacy
concept: Synthesizing checkbook management, credit, investing, wealth-building habits, and entrepreneurship knowledge into one coherent personal financial philosophy
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 financial literacy sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews the major concepts learned across all financial literacy grades and identifies which matter most to them personally
exercise.abstract: Student writes a personal financial philosophy statement drawing on concepts from across the full K-12 sequence

assessment.mastery_threshold: statement genuinely references at least three distinct concepts from across different grade levels of the sequence
misconception_flags: statement is generic and doesn't reference any specific concept actually learned in the curriculum

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
